manufacturer.name: Magnetic Autocontrol
manufacturer.note: German manufacturer of vehicle and pedestrian barriers, part of the FAAC group. No magnetic-access.com document URL surfaced, so supportUrl is null and the direct PDFs below are on a US distributor. Search mentions document IDs 5815,5001EN and 5815,5013US for the EU and US editions, but did not tie either to a URL - so neither is recorded as a documentCode against these files.

Search reports the manual restricts the barriers to road-vehicle access control and explicitly excludes railway crossings, and requires MAGNETIC safety light barriers - noted here because a technician should know those constraints exist, not recorded as fields, since they were read from a summary rather than the document.
